name: Sophia , Robot Prophet
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: Traditional prophets are often influenced by personal interests, and their predictions are often based on fallacies or evidence that often cannot be proven. Torah Codes aims to make sense of ancestral cultures from a perspective of analyzing language, cultures and their beliefs. With tools that allow the implementation of objective criteria on coding through an impartial analysis of the information in accepted modern scientific terms. In this way we can understand where myth and reality intersect and be able to shape the understanding we have about our ancestors and the origin of language.…
